name: Squarespace MCP
description: Brainstorm business names, check domain availability and pricing, and manage Squarespace store contacts, products and orders from Gemini, Claude or ChatGPT.

skills.name: Domain Search
skills.description: Brainstorms business names, checks domain availability and pricing, and returns a Squarespace checkout link to buy a domain.

skills.name: Products and Contacts
skills.description: Finds, creates and updates products and contacts on one of the user's Squarespace websites, with the user's own permissions.

skills.name: Order Lookup
skills.description: Looks up a website's orders read-only, for example to answer which orders still need shipping.
